summary: Q/C Technologies filed an 8-K reporting that on September 10, 2026, director Chelsea Voss resigned from the board and her January 16, 2026 consulting agreement was mutually terminated effective immediately; the company simultaneously terminated its December 8, 2025 consulting agreement with Ocean Avenue Holdings LLC, an entity affiliated with Martin Shkreli. Voss cited no disagreement with operations, policies or practices. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed. The abrupt, paired exits remove two outside consulting relationships, leaving a slim board and governance overhang; watch for follow-on resignations, control shifts, or strategic alternatives.
